name: rl-environments
description: Harness that captures OpenCode task attempts and packages them as RL environments.

scripts.test:package-e2e: npm run -s build && vitest run tests/e2e/package.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:restore-e2e: npm run -s build && vitest run tests/restore-e2e
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:live: set -a && source .env && set +a && npm run verify && vitest run tests/live
